scope: 動的Li Chao Treeの2周目。直線/線分Verify main・共通I/O・入力順を固定し、P-Coreのみで比較。

environment.compilers: 速度バイナリは明示/usr/bin/g++15.2.0。root実行とreadelf .commentで確認。サブ担当が最初に報告した15.3はPATH g++を確認した混同で訂正。query API補足だけPATH15.3が混ざる試験は各exact cmdを参照。
environment.method: コア別lock、候補の交互/乱択順、同一baseline実行ファイルcontrol。周波数は固定しない。

decisions.query_offset: unsigned offset/spanでqueryの座標範囲を保持する1案。公式28件を2シリーズ各6repで照合。差は同一controlの変動から分離できず不採用。
decisions.layout: alignas16の32Bノードとchildren-first24Bの2案。32Bはall_twice約24.4%とRSS約32.5%増、children-firstも追試all_intersect約2.7%増で不採用。
decisions.middle_values: 左右端の評価値から中点をstd::midpoint/bit平均で復元して2乗算を省く2案。root公式28件warmup1+7repで全出力一致、parabolaでstd約10〜12%/bit約5〜7%、all_intersectでstd約13%/bit約6%後退。不採用。
decisions.SIMD: 新旧直線×左右端の4個の64bit低位積をAVX2の32bit部分積3個で求める1案。孤立8repで約16%後退。CPU判定を省いた楽観条件でも不足し、fullmainへ統合せず不採用。通常auto-vectorizationを禁止していない。
decisions.production: 本体・公開API・所有権・main/I/O・使用例・Documentは変更しない。設定マクロ/CPU判定やSIMDコードを追加しない。

query/report.json.reason: Full-main gains were small and mixed, not repeatably separated from control variation. No stable no-regression claim. No repository changes.
query/report.json.reps: rep0 warmup+5 timed, variants randomly interleaved per case; expected bytes checked every run
query/report.json.same_binary_control: timings.json control executables copied byte-for-byte from baseline executables before run; screening controls had separately compiled identical source and differ in non-code metadata

api_validation.domains: full signed width, single point, irregular mixed sign, near min/max, 40 random per type
api_validation.operations: update, add_line, update_line_segment, add_segment, query, query_line, copies, assignments, moves, clear, reserve, empty, stored_nodes, domain bounds, validation exceptions
api_validation.toolchain_notes: Unqualified g++ resolves /usr/local/bin/g++ 15.3; all performance binaries explicitly used /usr/bin/g++ 15.2. GCC15.3 ASan link failed due absent runtime. Default clang stdlib discovery selected incomplete GCC16; fixed --gcc-install-dir=15. LeakSanitizer unsupported in environment, disabled leak tracing for ASan/UBSan rerun.

query/simd/report.json.candidate: AVX2 packed 4x int64 low product via 3 vpmuludq plus shifts/adds; signed comparison bit mask
query/simd/report.json.reason: Even optimistic isolated evaluation without CPU dispatch is about 16% slower than scalar 4x imul; no full-main candidate created.
query/simd/report.json.harness: same executable, direct noinline functions, 8 randomized interleaved repeats of scalar/control/avx2 for each size; control uses exact scalar branch
query/simd/report.json.validation: Every input checked against independent signed __int128 mathematical reference before timing. Includes random signed inputs, INT64_MIN/MAX, negative products and overflow-cancellation (INT64_MAX*2+INT64_MIN, INT64_MIN*(-1)-1); final mathematical values are int64-representable. All checksums identical for all timed variants.
query/simd/report.json.assembly: AVX2 function exactly 3 vpmuludq; scalar exactly 4 imul. AVX512 explicitly disabled.
adoption_requirements_if_revisited: scalar fallback for other types and unsupported CPUs
SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD removes both added SIMD and CPU detection
full-main verification and timing including dispatch cost
query/simd/report.json.autovectorization: Compiler default O2 auto-vectorization left enabled; no -fno-tree-vectorize or similar flags. AVX512 alone disabled for both scalar/AVX2 as requested.
query/simd/report.json.call_overhead: Both variants use one direct noinline function call for the same four products/two comparisons; dispatch occurs only once outside the timed per-input loops. AVX2 vzeroupper remains part of actual helper cost. Scalar control repeats the exact same scalar branch.
query/simd/report.json.production: No production changes or CPU dispatch added; isolated candidate rejected.

limits: 不採用候補の完全な全API正当性を確定したという意味ではない。追加の高速化を主張しない。全入力/CPU/コンパイラで最適とは断定しない。
